compiled_state.title: [T1][RED] Write failing tests for commit-step truncation immunity
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Create tests/scripts/test-commit-step-truncation.sh with the following test cases:

1. test_pipe_to_tail_artifact_intact: run 'dso commit-step lint "$LINT_CMD" 2>&1 | tail -3'; verify lint.result artifact exists and contains correct exit_code
2. test_pipe_to_devnull_artifact_intact: run 'dso commit-step lint "$LINT_CMD" >/dev/null 2>&1'; verify lint.result artifact exists
3. test_grep_filter_artifact_intact: run with grep -v filter on stdout; verify lint.result unchanged
4. test_failing_cmd_artifact_records_failure: underlying command fails (exit 1); verify lint.result contains exit_code=1 (failure not hidden by pipe)
5. test_verifier_sees_failure_through_tail: full E2E — commit-step writes artifact with failure, then verifier reads artifact and blocks

Classification: RED
Dependencies: none
Use WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env var for test isolation.

comments.body: Evaluator verdict: REVISE — truncation immunity already implemented by design (commit-step.sh captures inner stdout/stderr to temp files, emitting nothing to its own stdout). All 5 tests pass immediately as regression guards. Reclassified as UPDATE/regression-guard; no GREEN implementation needed for 4353.
